prompt_summary: Three small-size-first variants of the user-selected Module Dock direction

items.name: A1 开放托盘
items.description: A charcoal open-top U-shaped tray holding three broad modules, violet side modules and one off-white center module; no enclosing app tile

items.name: A2 紫色底座
items.description: A thick violet U-shaped dock as the dominant silhouette, holding three broad charcoal and off-white module tabs

items.name: A3 完整应用块
items.description: A solid violet rounded-square application block with a single broad three-tab negative-space motif and a short charcoal lower anchor
